coordinateConventions.shapePaths: SVG path data in the shape's local bounding box; this file uses a 100 by 100 reference box unless a component specifies its own dimensions.
coordinateConventions.componentGeometry: Component builder coordinates are local to an insertion origin at x=0,y=0. Component bounds give the reference width and height.
coordinateConventions.connectorAnchors: Normalized x/y fractions of a component's bounds. Standard ports are included for every catalog component; explicit per-instance ports are stored in libraryComponent.connectionPoints or group.connectionPoints.
coordinateConventions.pathElements: SVG path nodes use pathWidth/pathHeight as their local coordinate base. Element x/y/w/h place and scale that path on the canvas.
